Load packages and the data
```{R}
library(devtools)
load_all('/home/salbalkus/Research/RieszCML/')

library(nadir)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(vaccine)


```

First, load and clean the vaccine trial data.
```{R}
data(hvtn505)
df <- hvtn505 %>% filter(trt == 1)
df_complete_treated <- df %>% drop_na() %>% mutate(Y = HIVwk28preunbl)

head(df)
```

Next, we will Riesz represent the parameter of interest, which is the mean outcome under a shift in the treatment variable, under complete data.

```{R}
rc <- function(delta){return(RieszCurve$new(
  nuis = function(df) {

    # regression for Y given current history
    m_fit <- glm(Y ~ IgG_env + age + BMI + bhvrisk,
                 family = binomial(),
                 data = df)

    # treatment mechanism for A2
    df_shift <- df %>% mutate(IgG_env = IgG_env + delta)
    df_aug <- rbind(cbind(df, I = 0), cbind(df_shift, I = 1))
    r_fit <- glm(I ~ IgG_env + age + BMI + bhvrisk,
                 family = binomial(),
                 data = df_aug)


    list(
      m = predict(m_fit, newdata = df, type = "response"),
      m1 = predict(m_fit, newdata = df_shift, type = "response"),
      r = predict(r_fit, newdata = df_shift, type = "response")
    )
  },
  h = ~ m1 - Y,
  f = ~ m,
  alpha = ~ r / (1 - r),
  ic_expr = ~ h + alpha * (Y - f)
))}

est_tmle_complete <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df_complete_treated,
  rc = rc(0.1),
  fluctuation = "logistic",
  bounds = c(min(df_complete_treated$Y), max(df_complete_treated$Y)),
  outcome_col = "Y",
  use_intercept_and_weights = FALSE
)

print(est_tmle_complete)

```

```{r}
df_updated <- left_join(df, data.frame(pub_id = df_complete_treated$pub_id, Y = est_tmle_complete$h_star), by = "pub_id")
# Replace NAs so they don't break anything when we multiply by an indicator
df_updated$Y[is.na(df_updated$Y)] <- 0
df_updated$wt[is.na(df_updated$wt)] <- 1


rc_cc <- RieszCurve$new(
  nuis = function(df_updated) {
    # regression for Y given current history
    df_complete <- df_updated %>% drop_na()
    m_fit <- glm(Y ~ HIVwk28preunbl,
                 family = gaussian(),
                 data = df_complete)


    # we already have IC weights, so we can just use those as the "propensity score" for the shift
    # m and m1 are the same since we only operate in the complete data

    list(
      m = predict(m_fit, newdata = df_updated, type = "response"),
      m1 = predict(m_fit, newdata = df_updated, type = "response"),
      invprop = df_updated$casecontrol * df_updated$wt
    )
  },
  h = ~ m1,
  f = ~ m,
  alpha = ~ invprop,
  ic_expr = ~ h + alpha * (Y - f)
)

est_tmle <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df_updated,
  rc = rc_cc,
  fluctuation = "logistic",
  bounds = c(min(df_updated$Y), max(df_updated$Y)),
  outcome_col = "Y",
  use_intercept_and_weights = FALSE
)

print(est_tmle)

```
